title: Câu điều kiện loại 3: If I had known…
summary: Nói về quá khứ không có thật, tiếc nuối và trách móc: if + had V3, would have + V3.

dialogue.en: Why didn't you come to the party?
Nobody told me. [[If]] I [[had known]], I [[would have come]].
dialogue.vi: Có ai báo mình đâu. Nếu biết thì mình đã đến.

dialogue.en: Oh no! I sent the message to your old number.
dialogue.vi: Thôi chết! Mình gửi tin vào số cũ của bạn.

dialogue.en: [[If]] you [[had called]] me, I [[would have answered]].
dialogue.vi: Nếu bạn gọi thì mình đã nghe máy rồi.

dialogue.en: Sorry. [[If]] I [[hadn't been]] so busy, I [[would have checked]].
dialogue.vi: Xin lỗi. Nếu không bận quá thì mình đã kiểm tra lại.

sections.heading: If + had V3, would have + V3
sections.rule: Loại 3: **If + had + V3, would have + V3**. Nói về **quá khứ**: điều đã không xảy ra.
body: Khi nói thường rút gọn: *I'd have*, *would've* (đọc /ˈwʊdəv/). Viết *would of* là sai.
Có thể dùng **could have** (đã có thể) hoặc **might have** (có lẽ đã) thay cho would have.

examples.en: [[If]] I [[had left]] earlier, I [[would have caught]] the train.
examples.vi: Nếu đi sớm hơn thì tôi đã kịp tàu.
examples.why: Thực tế: đi muộn, lỡ tàu.

examples.vi: Cô ấy đã đỗ nếu chịu học.

examples.en: [[If]] it [[hadn't rained]], we [[could have gone]] to the beach.
examples.vi: Nếu trời không mưa thì chúng tôi đã có thể ra biển.
examples.why: Could have: khả năng đã có thể.

check.prompt: If I had seen you, I ___ hello.

sections.heading: Tiếc nuối và trách móc
sections.rule: Loại 3 dùng để **tiếc nuối** (*giá mà…*) hoặc **trách** nhẹ về chuyện đã qua, không thay đổi được.

examples.en: [[If]] I [[had saved]] money, I [[wouldn't have]] this problem now.
examples.vi: Giá mà tôi tiết kiệm thì giờ đâu có rắc rối này.
examples.why: Kết hợp: quá khứ (loại 3) dẫn đến hiện tại (would + V).

examples.en: [[If]] you [[had listened]] to me, this [[wouldn't have happened]].
examples.vi: Nếu bạn nghe tôi thì chuyện này đã không xảy ra.

check.prompt: If you ___ me, I would have helped you.

sections.heading: Loại 2 hay loại 3?
sections.rule: Loại 2: **hiện tại** không thật (*If I had a car…*). Loại 3: **quá khứ** không thật (*If I had had a car…*).

head: Loại
Thời gian
Ví dụ
rows: If I knew, I would tell you.
If I had known, I would have told you.

examples.vi: Nếu có thời gian, tôi sẽ giúp bạn.
examples.why: Bây giờ không có thời gian → loại 2.

examples.en: [[If]] I [[had had]] time yesterday, I [[would have helped]] you.
examples.vi: Nếu hôm qua có thời gian thì tôi đã giúp bạn.
examples.why: Hôm qua đã qua → loại 3: had had.

check.prompt: If I ___ about the meeting yesterday, I would have come.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have come.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have come.
mistakes.why: Không dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

mistakes.wrong: If I had knew, I would have told you.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have told you.

mistakes.wrong: If she had studied, she would pass.
mistakes.right: If she had studied, she would have passed.
mistakes.why: Kết quả trong quá khứ → would have + V3.
Viết would have (would've), không viết would of.

mistakes.wrong: If we left earlier yesterday, we would have arrived on time.
mistakes.right: If we had left earlier yesterday, we would have arrived on time.
mistakes.why: Quá khứ không thật → had + V3.

exercises.prompt: If he had driven more carefully, he ___ the accident.
If I ___ the alarm, I wouldn't have been late.
We could have won if we ___ harder.
Câu nào nói về quá khứ?
options: If I had money, I'd buy it.
If I'd had money, I'd have bought it.
exercises.explain: Had had + would have bought → loại 3.

exercises.prompt: If you had told me, I ___ you.
answers: would have helped
'd have helped

exercises.prompt: If she ___ the bus, she would have been on time.
answers: hadn't missed
had not missed

exercises.prompt: They would have enjoyed the trip if the weather ___ better.
answers: had been

exercises.prompt: If I had known you were sick, I ___ visited you.
answers: would have
'd have

exercises.prompt: If we had booked earlier, we ___ have got a cheaper ticket.
answers: could
would

exercises.vi: Nếu biết thì tôi đã giúp bạn.
alternatives: I would have helped you if I had known.
exercises.explain: If + had known, would have helped.

exercises.vi: Giá mà hôm qua bạn gọi cho tôi.
exercises.explain: If only + had + V3: tiếc nuối.

exercises.sentence: If I had studied, I would pass the exam last year.
answers: If I had studied, I would have passed the exam last year.

exercises.sentence: If she would have asked, I would have said yes.
answers: If she had asked, I would have said yes.

exercises.sentence: If they had came, they would have met him.
answers: If they had come, they would have met him.

exercises.vi: Nếu trời không mưa thì chúng tôi đã đi dã ngoại.
answers: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone on a picnic.
If it had not rained, we would have gone on a picnic.
If it hadn't rained, we'd have gone on a picnic.
If it hadn't rained, we would have had a picnic.
If it had not rained, we would have had a picnic.
We would have gone on a picnic if it hadn't rained.
We would have had a picnic if it hadn't rained.
exercises.explain: If + hadn't + V3, would have + V3.

exercises.vi: Nếu tôi biết thì tôi đã nói với bạn rồi.
answers: If I had known, I would have told you.
If I'd known, I would have told you.
If I had known, I'd have told you.
If I'd known, I'd have told you.
I would have told you if I had known.
exercises.explain: If + had known, would have told.
